```javascript
return Number(Number(s.replace(/,/g, '')).toFixed(2)) * 100;
```
to:
```javascript
return Math.round(Number(Number(s.replace(/,/g, '')).toFixed(2)) * 100);
```

In `src/locale.js` line 18, change:
```javascript
return parseFloat(text.replace(/\./g, '').replace(',', '.')) * 100;
```
to:
```javascript
return Math.round(parseFloat(text.replace(/\./g, '').replace(',', '.')) * 100);
```

These wrap the `* 100` operations with `Math.round()` to handle floating-point precision errors. Try applying these changes to your local copy and the error should go away.
